entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane where humanity is prey to werewolves, vampires, zombies, geists, demons and other horrors once the moon rises.

entities.name: The Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The human church named for its leader, the archangel Avacyn, which humans brandish against the horrors.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: A powerful archangel created by Sorin Markov to safeguard humanity; she is trapped in the Helvault, released, then driven mad and unmade.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker who created Avacyn to safeguard humanity and later unmade her.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon who trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him.

entities.name: The Helvault
entities.description: A prison in which Griselbrand trapped Avacyn; it was later sundered.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The high city of Innistrad, marched on by zombie armies.

entities.name: The cathars
entities.description: Specialized holy warriors trained by humans to strike back at supernatural horrors.

events.summary: Humans fight back with torch-wielding mobs, trained cathars, and the power of the Church of Avacyn.
events.quote: They train specialized holy warriors called cathars to strike back against the supernatural horrors.

events.summary: Griselbrand traps Avacyn in the Helvault with him, weakening the rites that invoked her and humanity's defenses.
events.quote: First the demon Griselbrand trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him

events.summary: With zombie armies marching on Thraben, the Helvault is sundered and Avacyn is released.
events.quote: the Helvault was sundered and Avacyn was released.

events.summary: Madness sweeps Innistrad as hope of Avacyn's protection turns to horror.
events.quote: Madness swept over Innistrad as the fleeting hope of Avacyn's angelic protection turned to horror.

events.summary: Sorin Markov intervenes and unmakes Avacyn, his beloved creation, and the plane's last protections fall.
events.quote: Sorin Markov finally intervened, unmaking his beloved creation.

relations.note: Created to safeguard humanity and let it coexist with its predators.
relations.quote: the powerful archangel Avacyn who was created by the Planeswalker Sorin Markov to safeguard humanity

relations.note: The Church is named for its leader.
relations.quote: The Church is named for its leader, the powerful archangel Avacyn

relations.note: He trapped her in the Helvault.
relations.quote: First the demon Griselbrand trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him
Sorin Markov finally intervened, unmaking his beloved creation.
